description: This file defines classes and functions for generating and managing CuteDSL (CUTLASS Python DSL) kernels within the PyTorch Inductor compilation framework. It includes kernel wrappers, subgraph information, code generation utilities, and operation overload handling specific to CuteDSL, facilitating the creation of custom CUDA kernels with symbolic and template-based code generation.

classes.name: CuteDSLKernelWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class to provide a .run() interface for CuteDSL kernels, encapsulating the kernel function and optional kernel path, and executing kernels with provided arguments.

classes.name: CuteDSLSubgraphInfo
classes.description: Dataclass storing minimal subgraph information for CuteDSL kernels, including the body buffer, optional mask/out templates, and common subexpression elimination (CSE) object.

classes.name: CuteDSLTemplateKernel
classes.description: Main class representing a CuteDSL kernel with code generation, argument handling, subgraph management, and kernel invocation functionalities, tailored for generating CUDA kernels using CuteDSL syntax.

classes.name: ModificationWrapperCuteDSL
classes.description: Handler class enabling code generation during subgraph modifications, converting PyTorch IR ops to CuteDSL, managing placeholders, and limiting supported operations to pointwise.

methods.name: run(self, *args, stream=None, **kwargs)
methods.description: Executes the wrapped kernel function with specified arguments, stream, and keyword arguments.

methods.name: to_dict(self)
methods.description: Serializes CuteDSLSubgraphInfo to a dictionary for easy inspection.

methods.name: str kexpr(self, expr: sympy.Expr)
methods.description: Converts a sympy expression into a string suitable for CuteDSL code.

methods.name: str gen_imports(self)
methods.description: Generates the import statements required at the start of CuteDSL kernel code.

methods.name: str gen_defines(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Generates kernel parameter definitions from key-value pairs, similar to Triton's gen_defines.

methods.name: render(self, template, **kwargs)
methods.description: Renders a kernel template with environment variables and arguments, returning a PartialRender object.

methods.name: set_subgraph_body(self, body_name: str)
methods.description: Context manager for setting and restoring subgraph body state during code generation.

methods.name: create_subgraph_body(self, body_name: str, *, clear_cse: bool = False)
methods.description: Context manager for creating and initializing a new subgraph body.

methods.name: ReinterpretView|None _get_reinterpret_view(self, node)
methods.description: Extracts or converts a node to a ReinterpretView, handling all view types.

methods.name: def_kernel(self, *argnames)
methods.description: Defines the kernel function signature in the template, creating input args for views and shared buffers.

methods.name: get_output(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the output buffer's argument name for kernel invocation.

methods.name: set_cute_hash(self, func_name: str, suffix: str = "")
methods.description: Generates code to set a unique __cute_hash__ attribute on a kernel function for caching optimization.

methods.name: get_tensor_buffers(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of tensor buffer names collected during modifications.

methods.name: unpack_buffers(self, buffer_list_name: str, *, indent_width: int = 4)
methods.description: Generates code to unpack tensor buffers into variables using registered render hooks.

methods.name: call_kernel(self, name: str, node=None)
methods.description: Generates code to invoke the kernel with appropriate arguments, handling reinterpret views.

methods.name: _get_subgraph(self, subgraph_number: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subgraph by its index for modification processing.

methods.name: str modification( self, subgraph_number: int, output_name: Optional[str], mask: Optional[str] = None, **fixed_inputs, )
methods.description: Performs a subgraph modification, generating corresponding CuteDSL code, including handling of overlays, buffers, and subgraph bodies.

methods.name: load(self, name: str, index: sympy.Expr)
methods.description: Handles loading tensor data from buffers or fixed inputs, converting symbolic indices as needed.

methods.name: str _emit_scalar_fragment( self, expr_str: str, cute_dtype: str, torch_dtype: torch.dtype )
methods.description: Converts SSA expressions to indexable scalar code for tensor loads, working around gather limitations.

methods.name: indirect_indexing(self, index_var: str, size, check, wrap_neg=True)
methods.description: Converts index variables to symbolic form for indexing.
